name: Intermezzo: Revisiting Helmut Newton (Museum of Photography Reopening)
venue: Museum of Photography / Helmut Newton Foundation
description: After a two-month modernization break, the Museum of Photography reopens with a reinvented permanent exhibition on Helmut Newton. 'Intermezzo' transforms the ground floor into an immersive film space, offering a completely new way to experience the lives of Helmut and June Newton through previously unseen archive material. Alongside this, the museum presents 'New Woman, New Vision,' spotlighting female pioneers of Bauhaus photography with around 300 works including portraits, architectural photography, and abstract experimental pieces.
